comments.author: squaredot
comments.story_title: Understanding Convolutions in Probability: A Mad-Science Perspective
comments.why_zh: FFT 应用于多项式乘法
comments.quote_zh: 关于 FFT 应用于多项式乘法，有一个非常出色且令人愉快的视频是
comments.text_zh: 正如作者提到的，用于信号处理的卷积和用于概率的卷积本质上是两个不同语境下的同一种东西。有趣的是，同一个概念也支撑着多项式乘法。在离散情形下，我们可以把表示……的向量作类比：（离散化的）概率密度 <-> （离散的）信号强度 <-> 多项式的系数 …… 分别对应各自的语境。如果看离散情形，由于卷积运算的计算代价很高（O(n^3)），人们常常依赖快速傅里叶变换算法（FFT），它的运行时间是 O(n log(n))。关于 FFT 应用于多项式乘法，有一个非常出色且令人愉快的视频：[VIDEO]。
comments.text: As the author mentions, convolutions for signal processing and convolutions for probability are essentially equivalent things in two different contexts. It is interesting that the same concept is behind the multiplication of polynomials. In the discrete case we have the parallel of the vectors representing ... the (discretized) probability density <-> the (discrete) signal intensity <-> the coefficients of the polynomial ... in the respective context. If we look at the discrete case, since the operation of convolution is computationally expensive (O(n^3)), people often rely on the Fast Fourier Transform Algorithm (FFT), that runs in O(n log(n)). An excellent and very enjoyable video on the FFT applied to the polynomial multiplication is [VIDEO] .

comments.author: foooobaba
comments.why_zh: 涵盖了 FFT 在多项式插值和乘法中的应用
comments.text_zh: 相关：快速傅里叶变换（FFT）可用于在 O(nlogn) 时间内做多项式插值（前提是你能自己选点，并使用“单位复根”），其中 n 是多项式的次数；它也被用作 O(nlogn) 多项式乘法中的一个步骤。这个视频讲得很好：[VIDEO] 另外还有 CLRS 第 30 章：[LINK]
comments.text: Related: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) can be used for polynomial interpolation in O(nlogn) time (if you get to choose the points, and use “complex roots of unity”), where n is the degree of the polynomial, and is used as a step in multiplication of polynomials in O(nlogn) as well. This video covers it well: [VIDEO] Also, chapter 30 of CLRS: [LINK]
